description: POST /context/ingest takes an `app_knowledge` form part (app sources as a JSON-encoded array) that the spec's multipart schema omits, so the generated ingestContext input could not send it. Evidence: the official TypeScript SDK @hydradb/sdk 2.1.8 (Fern-generated by HydraDB) types it as `IngestContextRequest.appKnowledge?: string` ('App knowledge entries to ingest, encoded as a JSON array.') and appends it as the multipart part `app_knowledge` (dist/api/resources/context/client/Client.js, __ingest); HydraDB's agent guide (https://docs.hydradb.com/AGENTS.md, sections 2 and 6 and the raw-HTTP example in 15.2) documents `-F 'app_knowledge=[...]'` on the same endpoint. Spec: https://docs.hydradb.com/api-reference/v2/openapi.json (OpenAPI 0.1.0, fetched 2026-11-14).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: App knowledge entries to ingest, encoded as a JSON array (`kind`, `fields`, `metadata`, ... per source). Use `type=knowledge`.
